posting.title: Lead Data Scientist
posting.description:
About the role:
Nordbridge Analytics is a Copenhagen-based fintech scale-up building forecasting and risk-scoring products for Nordic banks. We are hiring a Lead Data Scientist to build out our data science function from the ground up and set the technical direction for the team.

Responsibilities:
You will design and own end-to-end ML pipelines for credit-risk and churn models, working closely with engineering to ship them to production. You will define the data science roadmap and mentor a small team of data scientists. You will collaborate with product and engineering leadership on data-driven feature decisions.

Requirements:
5+ years of experience in data science or applied machine learning, including some experience leading a small team or workstream is required. Strong hands-on experience with Python (scikit-learn, PyTorch, pandas) is required. Solid SQL skills and experience with AWS and Spark for large-scale data processing are required. Experience with data visualization tools (d3, matplotlib) is a plus. Experience mentoring junior team members is a plus.

Location and work mode:
This is a hybrid role based in our Copenhagen office, with three days a week in the office and flexibility to work from home the rest of the week.

What we offer:
Competitive salary, pension contributions, and a collaborative, low-ego engineering culture.
